# nvidia/cluster-readiness-engine v0.6.0, base default

**UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL**

This bundle holds the 43 Kubernetes objects that Helm rendered for release nvcre in namespace nvcre, and the files that say what those objects need. The flattening verdict for this base is flatten-with-routes.

## What the bundle holds

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `upstream.yaml` | The 43 rendered objects, byte for byte as the Catalog retains them. |
| `routes/crd-ordering.yaml` | The order to apply the objects in, definitions first. |
| `requirements/target-requirements.yaml` | What the target must already have. |

## Before you apply it

- The bundle holds no Namespace object, so the namespace nvcre must exist on the target before these objects are applied. 4 objects of a custom kind set no namespace. This file does not decide whether those kinds are namespaced.
- Apply the 7 CustomResourceDefinitions first and wait until each is established. `routes/crd-ordering.yaml` declares that order.
- The target must already have the definition `servicemonitors.monitoring.coreos.com`. This bundle does not hold it.

## What has not been done

No route in this bundle has been run on a cluster, and no destination has been checked against the requirements. The bundle holds no container image, no Helm hook object and no Secret.
